name: Vikings

global_influences.evidence: Positioned in coverage as a Dhaka rock band of the late-1990s cohort; no specific influence statements by members were locatable in available sources.
global_influences.source: Band pages and press coverage; no interview-level influence statement located

local_adaptation_notes: Bangla-language rock from the late-1990s cohort — the generation that formed after original Bangla metal was established but before the 2000s progressive wave.
sound_evolution_summary: Sparsely documented. The band's most reported event is the 2020 departure of founding vocalist Tonmoy Tansen after 23 years, citing a breakdown in mutual understanding among members — an instance of the lineup-churn pattern that recurs across the catalogue's long-lived bands.
concert_culture_notes: Performed at the sixth Joy Bangla Concert (2020).
listener_community_notes: Insufficiently documented in accessible sources; the band's audience profile is not established.
